lsu.citation: J. R. Langley, K. L. Riley (C. A. Whitehurst, B. S. Pressburg, PIs), 'Flow Losses in Flexible Hose, Vol. I, Final Report', Louisiana State Univ., Contract NAS 9-4630, Sept 1966, NASA-CR-62061 (NTRS 19680012628). Eq. 29-35 (straight), Eq. 32 (curved).
lsu.friction_factor: Fanning, f_F = alpha * Re^beta, D = minimum inside diameter

bend.form: f/f0 = 1 + a * (D / R_B)^n over the bent arc

hawthorne.citation: R. C. Hawthorne & H. C. von Helms, 'Fluid expansion theory computes flow in corrugated hose', Product Engineering, June 10 1963, pp. 98-100. Eq. 2-6.
hawthorne.form: C = [1 - (D/(D + 2k))^2]^2 per corrugation, k = 0.219 * pitch; dP = (N*C + C_B) * rho V^2 / 2
